info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Actions Management API
info.description: The Operational Actions Management API enables users to execute various operational tasks within the banking IT management platform. This API facilitates the creation of operational actions, allowing users to initiate processes that optimize and enhance operational efficiency. Typical consumers of this API include IT staff and operational managers looking to streamline platform operations. Through efficient management of these actions, organizations can improve their operational processes and respond to changes swiftly.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new operational action within the platform. You can define various parameters and settings that govern the operational action's behavior and characteristics.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized for initiating operational actions within the IT management platform. It should contain all necessary details required to specify the type of action to be taken and any relevant parameters.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing, but the processing is not yet complete.

actionType.description: The type of action to be performed.

priority.description: The priority level of the action.

reason.description: The reason for the action request.

requestedBy.description: Identifier of the user who requested the action.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp when the action was requested.

CreateOperationalActionRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for operational actions.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request.

correlationId.description: A correlation identifier to trace related requests.

idempotencyKey.description: A key to ensure the request is processed only once.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp when the request context was created.

sourceSystem.description: Name of the system generating the request.

sourceApplication.description: Name of the application initiating the request.

channelId.description: Unique identifier for the communication channel.

deviceId.description: Identifier of the device used for the request.

Channel.description: Information about the communication channel used for the request.

CreateOperationalActionResponse_202.title: Operation Response

actionReference.description: A reference identifier for the action performed.

actionType.description: The type of action that was performed.

status.description: The current status of the operation.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the action was processed.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the operation request.

CreateOperationalActionResponse_202.description: Schema representing the response for an operation request, containing information about the action performed and metadata associated with the request.

OperationMetadata.title: Operation Metadata

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: An identifier used to correlate different requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region in which the processing of the request took place.

OperationMetadata.description: Schema representing metadata associated with an operation request.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint being accessed. This ID helps in tracing and managing requests within the platform.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application handling the runtime execution of this operation. This header provides context for the processing environment.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme allows clients to authenticate by using a Bearer token in the HTTP Authorization header. The token must be a valid JSON Web Token (JWT), which encodes the user identity and claims.
